messages:
sam (runtime): Quick heads-up — planning a kernel v2.3.0 + quant-build 0.9 deploy during quiet window tonight 02:00 UTC. Deploybot will slice traffic and sticky-pin for 1h. Please ack if you have any conflicts.
janet (release): ACK. I'll draft release notes and include rollback instructions. Which tests must pass for the prod cut?
kevin (sre): Must have smoke: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5% for 15m on canary. Also watch memory headroom & OOM spikes. If any regression -> immediate rollback.
sam (runtime): Tests: unit smoke in staging green, e2e latency job green, quant-compat parity check (kv-cache snapshots) green. Deploybot preflight will run smoke.sh and verify checksums. Tag: kernel-v2.3.0-quant0.9.
deploybot: scheduling canary slices: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 30m. Will emit events to #eng-runtime and #eng-sre. Auto-rollback policy: enabled on any p95 regression > 20% or error rate > 1.0% during increase window.
carla (oncall): I'm oncall tonight, will monitor telemetry and live-tail. Add me to escalation if we see +15% latency or memory anomalies.
nate (eng): For Dedicated customers, recommend pinning engine variant for 24h post-cut. Are we doing that?
sam (runtime): Yes — sticky pin: dedicated=24h, hosted=1h. After 24h we'll lift pins gradually and run a slow traffic sweep.
janet (release): Release notes draft bullets: kernel v2.3.0 changelog, quant matmul op fix, fallback behavior (runtime will fallback to quant-compat v0.8 on specific kernel failures). I'll open PR with runbook and revert steps.
kevin (sre): Rollback criteria (formal): 1) canary error rate > 1% for 10m; 2) p95 > baseline + 40ms for 10m; 3) mem OOMs or GPU OOM occurrences; 4) >2 customer-facing 500s in 5m. If triggered -> deploybot rollback to kernel-v2.2.7 and pin until investigation.
sam (runtime): Agreed. Add a staged degrade option: if small latency blip we flip to smaller internal batch sizes and enable prefix cache bypass before full rollback. That buys time.
carla (oncall): I'll watch live-tail and flamegraphs. If we trigger rollback: @sam to initiate deploybot revert, @kevin to validate infra/metrics and confirm rollback executed.
sam (runtime): I'll run the revert and call for a postmortem if we rollback. /cc @janet to update release notes after the event.
janet (release): Will prepare post-rollback changelog template and an email to CS if we revert.
kevin (sre): One more preflight item: tag the quant build with checksum and signature. Example: sha256:abc123def456... Deploybot will validate signature; preflight fails on mismatch.
sam (runtime): Copy that. Final ask: all approvers please react :thumbsup: if you're good. We'll start preflight at 01:30 UTC and cut at 02:00 UTC.
carla (oncall): :thumbsup:
kevin (sre): :thumbsup:
janet (release): :thumbsup:
nate (eng): :thumbsup:
sam (runtime): Thanks everyone — logging start times in the release doc and adding a short checklist (smoke, checksum, canary slices, pinned TTLs).
